sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Ridge cap, starter shingle, hip and ridge vent need product-specific French trade senses. Archived bardeau de faîtage, bardeau de départ, arêtier and évent de faîtage may fit a particular system or region; settle the approved product and dictionary context before selecting scored terminology.

Source card 10 unconditionally commands cutting ridge caps from a starter shingle, but Reader 4 allows that only if the chosen product permits it. The archived French card retains the unqualified command while its Reader has the condition. Resolve whether to revise the source card and dependent mode/audio text together; do not teach the unqualified command as universal.

Ridge-cap placement, ridge-vent method and sealing the last cap depend on the chosen roof system. The source lacks product fastener, vent, sealant and finish details; qualified roofing/product review must settle the work instruction before a French construction command or audio script is selected.

Source finish is a noun while archived finition is a noun, and final cleanup is distinct from sealing. Preserve these senses when authoring forms and six modes; the archived speaking asks product-permission detail beyond the source's brief objective and remains separate evidence.
